gold: Bullous lichen planus of the nails

selector.rationale: The patient's symptoms, including painful swelling of the proximal nail folds, lichenoid plaques on the oral mucosa, and histopathology results showing hyperkeratosis, acanthosis, and basal cell degeneration, are all consistent with lichen planus.
